description: Ask OpenVibe.Chat for the sound of one line, in the person own voice and on the person allowance (the Agent Streams plan, S4). The caller presents a service token for audience openvibe.chat that names the person it acts for (a node token on_behalf_of), so the voice is that person and never another. The text is one line (220 characters at most). The answer is the audio (base64) with its type; the desk mixes it into the stream Opus track. A person own cloned voice is asked for by name and only by that person.
